name: treeroom-hatch-going-down
js: state.music.mute = true; const B = state.background; Object.assign(B, { kind: "treeroom", houses: 6, ladders: 6, bridges: 6, inside: 1, figX: 0, figY: 0 }); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); measureMarks(); const L = marks.ladders.find(L => L.down != null && L.door) || marks.ladders.find(L => L.down != null); if (L) { B.figX = Math.round(L.x); B.figY = Math.round(L.z - SCENE.ground); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); measureMarks(); touchWant(true); const p = touchPad.pad.buttons[13]; p.pressed = true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); p.pressed = false; }
